//: Reviewed npm-audit exceptions: pnpm workspace (pnpm-lock.yaml).
An entry here suppresses ONE advisory id on ONE package name in the CI
dependency audit (scripts/security/check-npm-audit.sh, HIGH+CRITICAL gate).
The bar for adding one is high. The advisory must have NO fixed release to
upgrade to. The advisory must also not be exploitable in production, by
one of two bars. Either the package is absent from the production
dependency closure of every shipped workspace package
(`pnpm -r why <pkg> --prod`) and from every built artifact, with that
evidence in the PR; or present in a production closure only where
the vulnerable function is provably never called at runtime, with a
negative runtime test and a positive control, both recorded in the entry
(in its `reason`). A public tracking issue must exist so the entry is
removed the moment a fixed release ships. An advisory with an available fix
must be fixed by upgrading (or a pnpm override), never listed here.
Enforced by check-npm-audit.sh on every run: exact id + package match only;
every entry is printed; an entry past `expires` fails the run even after
the advisory disappears; `expires` may be at most 30 days out, so renewing
an entry means re-reviewing it; a malformed or missing file fails the run.
Entry format:
id       OSV/GHSA id exactly as osv-scanner reports it
package  npm package name exactly as osv-scanner reports it
reason   which bar applies and the evidence for it (for the second bar, the negative runtime test and positive control), and the tracking issue as #<number>
expires  YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), the last day the exception is honoured

exceptions.reason: No fixed release as of 2026-11-18: the advisory covers <= 4.0.7, 4.0.7 is the latest published version, and it lists no patched release (upstream fix PRs micromatch/picomatch #237-#273 are open, none released). GitHub and VulnCheck withdrew the advisory on 2026-11-18 as disputed, so this scan may stop matching it; the entry stays until it expires because it anchors the mirrored .trivyignore entry for CVE-2026-112366, which Trivy still reports. Second bar, per image. api and api-compose: `pnpm why picomatch --prod` is empty for @breeze/api, and apps/api/Dockerfile's runner now copies node_modules from a prod-only install (prod-deps stage), so neither api image contains picomatch (Trivy image scan of the rebuilt api image: 0 HIGH/CRITICAL with no ignore). web, portal and web-compose: picomatch 4.0.7 is in the production closure (astro -> @astrojs/internal-helpers; also @astrojs/react, unstorage -> anymatch, tinyglobby -> fdir) and is bundled into dist/server/entry.mjs; 4.0.4 is in the web and portal node_modules through devDependencies only. Its only runtime caller is @astrojs/react's component filter, which is null because include and exclude are baked as undefined. Negative runtime test on each built image at main 016dcd4a49: counters on the bundled picomatch(), its internal-helpers wrapper and lib/parse.js parse(), the same counters on every node_modules copy, and a module.registerHooks load hook watching picomatch/anymatch/micromatch/tinyglobby/fdir/chokidar. Requests carried +(*a) and a 60-character backtracking subject in the path, query keys, query values, headers and POST bodies (web 103, portal 73, web-compose 103). Result: 0 picomatch calls, 0 parse calls, 0 watched module loads; islands rendered (@astrojs/react check(): web 930, portal 9, web-compose 913); every response under 1 s. Positive control: the same image with include baked as ['**/*.+(tsx|jsx)'] records 1 picomatch and 1 parse call, and requiring each node_modules copy in the same container records its loads and calls. Even then the pattern is build-time config, never request input. The shipped copy is vulnerable: 4.0.7 '+(*a)' against 'a'*n+'b' takes 16.7/65.9 ms at n=22/24 (x4 per 2 characters); a config-style pattern takes under 0.11 ms. docs (static build, no picomatch in dist) and mobile (no picomatch sources in the Hermes bundles) are as recorded in #12157, not re-run here. No client bundle of web or portal contains it. Tracking: #12155 (raised in #12114)
